name: Before § 1
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: -1. Recalls that the European Semester should remain a non-binding instrument for the coordination of the macroeconomic and fiscal policies of the Member States in order to ensure the underlying soundness of the EU’s monetary policy, with EU social competence playing a supporting role to Member States’ policies;
